changes: Updated the 3x2 review escalation execution plan to add an explicit degraded 3-round x 1-host fallback for cases where a second host is unavailable, unauthenticated, rate-limited, provider-down, or out of credits. The plan keeps full 3x2 as the default, separates unavailable-second-host from approved-single-host-local, and distinguishes requiredAssurance, effectiveAssurance, and achievedAssurance.
usage: Read docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md before implementing the review gate. Implement full 3x2 as the preferred path and allow degraded-single-host only when policy or explicit approval allows it, with visible lower-assurance reporting.
expectedOutcome: User sees that 3x2 remains the default, but Lattice has a documented degraded 3x1 fallback path when another host cannot be used because of credits, auth, runtime, outage, or rate limits.
actualTranscript: lattice validate --story=B-d959 --json --forceTakeover returned status=pass and allPass=true; npm test passed; verificationIntent coverage was 6/6. Delivery reviewer verified 5 docs promises and 3 real-machine test records.
outcomeDiff: No product gap for this documentation story. The requested fallback policy is documented and reviewed; runtime implementation remains a follow-up story.
limitations: Planning/documentation artifact only. It does not implement runtime degraded quorum behavior in packages/main/src yet.
pitfalls: Do not silently treat degraded 3x1 as full 3x2. User approval for approved-single-host-local is not proof that a second host was unavailable.
